actions.name: Complete setup (recommended)
actions.description: Install or repair every required component and verify the checkout.

actions.name: Check environment (read only)
actions.description: Verify required tools and project state without changing them.

actions.name: Update environment (includes MSYS2)
actions.description: Run the complete MSYS2 system update, update compatible tools/integrations and the checkout, then verify.

actions.name: Repair environment
actions.description: Reapply required state without ordinary upgrades.

actions.name: Choose and configure editors/IDEs
actions.description: Choose editors and install their GameWIP integrations.

actions.description: Install or repair declared UCRT64 and CLANG64 packages.

actions.name: Prepare repository
actions.description: Initialize pinned submodules and configure the development tree.

actions.name: Install project tools
actions.description: Install declared project tools using their configured providers.

actions.name: Build documentation
actions.description: Build, verify, and optionally open the generated manual.

actions.name: Install matching Tracy profiler tools
actions.description: Build and install tools matching the pinned Tracy client.

actions.name: Uninstall everything installed by GameWIP
actions.description: Remove setup-owned software, integrations, and generated setup artifacts.

actions.description: Apply the repository Visual Studio configuration.

actions.name: List setup actions
actions.description: List supported setup actions and their behavior.

actions.name: Show setup help
actions.description: Print command-line usage and common options.

actions.name: Open the interactive setup menu
actions.description: Open the persistent one-key setup menu.
